purpose: Normalize spoken developer language into precise technical syntax while preserving user intent, target, action, semantic meaning, and canonical implementation. Optimized for vibe coding and spoken Tailwind CSS workflows.

canonical_preferences.rule: The user primarily speaks 'bg'. Prefer bg-* in all canonical Tailwind output. Background and background color remain recognition aliases only and should not replace the canonical bg prefix.

tailwind_prefixes.notes: Always prefer bg-* when normalizing Tailwind background utilities.

bg_specific_normalization.rule: The semantic concept 'background color' may be recognized from speech, but the canonical implementation must use the Tailwind bg prefix.

Convert digit-by-digit speech into numeric shade.
